questions.stem: I was watching TV ____ my mother came back.

options.distractor: came back 是短暂动作，while 要接持续动作

questions.explanation: when 可以接短暂动作 came back。

questions.stem: ____ I was walking in the street, I met an old friend of mine.
questions.explanation: while 接持续性动作（进行时态）。

options.distractor: stopped 是过去时，主句也要用过去时
leave 是实义动词，用 didn't 否定

questions.explanation: 直到雨停才走 → didn't leave until。

questions.stem: — Please give him the message ____ he comes back. — OK, I will.
questions.explanation: 一回来就给 → as soon as。

options.text: I'll wait here until he comes.
He was reading while his sister was singing.
The baby stopped crying as soon as he saw his mother.
I will tell her the news when she will come.

questions.explanation: 时间从句要用一般现在时表将来：when she comes。

questions.stem: — Did you know he was ill? — Yes. I ____ about it ____ he told me.

options.distractor: told 是过去时，主句也要用过去时
“直到他告诉我才知道”用 not…until
缺少否定，意思变成“知道，直到他告诉我”

questions.explanation: 直到他告诉我才知道 → didn't know until。
